system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids

Space Beacons are used by pilots and flight crews to mark specific locations or to help navigate through hazardous areas of space. A beacon is 250 millimeters long and can transmit a signal throughout an entire star system, if it is not blocked by nebular gases or signal jamming systems. The Space Beacon Launcher- modeled after a small version of the standard Space Mine Launcher- enables a Droid to quickly position Space Beacons while in flight. The system can carry up to 12 beacons. Additional storage can be added, increasing the cost of the launcher by 10% for each additional beacon (up to a maximum of 24 beacons). Locating a beacon requires a DC 10 Use Computer check when using a ship's sensor system.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
